item.title: Sensex, Nifty turn positive after early losses ahead of key Q2 GDP data release
item.description: The Sensex rose 101 points to 85,821, up 0.12 per cent, while the Nifty inched up 35 points to 26,251, a gain of 0.14 per cent. "The Nifty seems likely to stay within a defined range, with near-term resistance in the 26,300–26,350 area and support near 26,050–26,100; dips toward this support zone may offer fresh buying opportunities," analysts said.

item.title: Gold, silver prices rise on strong demand
item.description: Meanwhile, the US dollar is set for its sharpest weekly fall in four months, as expectations of a US Fed rate cut continue to strengthen, further supporting precious metal prices. MCX Silver continues to display strong bullish behaviour after forming a rounded base pattern, reflecting healthy accumulation and a confirmed trend shift.

item.title: Man connected with firing at Kapil Sharma
item.description: The Delhi Crime Branch, led by DCP Sanjeev Yadav, arrested Sekhon, who is also known as Bandhu Maan Singh Shekhon, a prominent member of the Goldy Dhillon gang. Authorities seized a Chinese PX-3 pistol during the operation. The accused has a long criminal record and faces multiple cases in India.
